comment: options.c handler_number_pad() gives each row of its PICK_ONE menu the group accelerator '0' + i (5912). wintty.c process_menu_window() sends a digit that is a group accelerator to group_accel while no count is pending, so "3" picks "3 (on, phone-style digit layout)" and "0" then picks "0 (off)" without Return.
